1	# Conductor — Product Orchestrator
2	
3	General-purpose app/product orchestrator that manages the full lifecycle: requirements → phases → pipelines → code → review → deploy. Extracted from patterns proven in aldc-launchpad and neurospect orchestrators.
4	
5	## Architecture
6	
7	```
8	conductor/
9	├── engine/                 # Python backend
10	│   ├── server.py           # HTTP server + API routing
11	│   ├── sessions.py         # Claude Code session lifecycle
12	│   ├── pipelines.py        # DAG pipeline engine (YAML-driven)
13	│   ├── phases.py           # Phase manager (markdown-driven)
14	│   ├── memory.py           # Per-project memory store (zeus-memory patterns)
15	│   ├── agents.py           # Agent registry + dispatch
16	│   ├── context.py          # Pluggable context enrichment
17	│   ├── events.py           # Event system + SSE pub/sub
18	│   ├── scaffolder.py       # Project bootstrapping
19	│   └── stage_scripts/      # Pipeline automation scripts
20	├── dashboard/              # Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS SPA
21	│   ├── index.html          # SPA shell
22	│   ├── styles/base.css     # Design system
23	│   └── pages/              # Per-page HTML files
24	├── templates/              # Pipeline + stack templates
25	├── agents/                 # Agent definitions (.md files)
26	├── projects/               # Per-project configs, wikis, memory stores
27	│   ├── <slug>/project.json # Project registry + phase definitions
28	│   ├── <slug>/wiki/        # Per-project wiki (decisions, learnings, patterns)
29	│   ├── <slug>/memory/      # Per-project memory ledger (zeus-memory lite)
30	│   └── wiki-template/      # Wiki conventions template
31	└── shared/prompts/         # Reusable prompt fragments
32	```
33	
34	## Running
35	
36	```bash
37	python engine/server.py
38	# Serves on http://127.0.0.1:8888
39	```
40	
41	## API
42	
43	### Sessions
44	- `GET    /api/sessions` — list all sessions
45	- `POST   /api/sessions` — create + launch a session
46	- `GET    /api/sessions/{id}` — get session details
47	- `GET    /api/sessions/{id}/output` — get session output (JSONL)
48	- `PATCH  /api/sessions/{id}` — update quality gates / learnings
49	- `POST   /api/sessions/{id}/cancel` — cancel a running session
50	- `DELETE /api/sessions/{id}` — delete session + cleanup
51	
52	### Projects (Phase 1)
53	- `GET    /api/projects` — list projects
54	- `POST   /api/projects` — create project
55	- `GET    /api/projects/{slug}` — get project details
56	
57	### Pipelines (Phase 2)
58	- `GET    /api/pipelines` — list pipelines
59	- `POST   /api/pipelines` — create + start pipeline
60	- `GET    /api/pipelines/{id}` — get pipeline details
61	- `POST   /api/pipelines/{id}/advance` — advance past a gate
62	
63	### Events
64	- `GET    /api/events` — event history (query: `limit`, `type`, `since`)
65	- `GET    /api/events/stream` — SSE stream (real-time events)
66	- `GET    /api/events/stats` — event system statistics
67	
68	### Agents (Phase 3)
69	- `GET    /api/agents` — list available agents
70	- `POST   /api/agents/run` — run an agent
71	
72	### Memory (per-project, zeus-memory lite)
73	- `GET    /api/projects/{slug}/memory` — list memories (query: `type`, `status`, `limit`, `offset`)
74	- `POST   /api/projects/{slug}/memory` — store a memory
75	- `POST   /api/projects/{slug}/memory/store` — store a memory (alias)
76	- `POST   /api/projects/{slug}/memory/search` — keyword search memories
77	- `GET    /api/projects/{slug}/memory/{id}` — recall a memory + evidence
78	- `PATCH  /api/projects/{slug}/memory/{id}` — update a memory
79	- `POST   /api/projects/{slug}/memory/{id}/evidence` — link evidence to a memory
80	- `GET    /api/projects/{slug}/memory/stats` — memory store statistics
81	
82	### GrooveNet (project-specific)
83	- `GET    /api/groovenet/events` — list events
84	- `POST   /api/groovenet/events` — create event
85	- `GET    /api/groovenet/sets` — list DJ sets
86	- `POST   /api/groovenet/sets` — log a DJ set
87	- `GET    /api/groovenet/profile` — get DJ profile
88	- `PUT    /api/groovenet/profile` — update DJ profile
89	
90	## Data Layer
91	
92	All state persisted as JSON:
93	- `dashboard/data/sessions.json` — session state + config
94	- `dashboard/data/pipelines.json` — pipeline state
95	- `dashboard/data/projects.json` — project registry
96	- `dashboard/data/sessions/` — per-session JSONL output files
97	- `projects/<slug>/memory/memories.json` — per-project memory ledger
98	- `projects/<slug>/memory/evidence.json` — memory evidence links
99	- `projects/<slug>/memory/retrieval_log.json` — retrieval audit trail
100	
101	## Key Patterns
102	
103	- **Atomic writes**: state files written to `.tmp` then renamed
104	- **Binary pipe reading**: `bufsize=0` for Windows subprocess compatibility
105	- **Shared pipeline worktrees**: all stages in a pipeline share one git worktree
106	- **Quality gates**: `{compiles, tests_pass, requirements_met, no_security_issues}` per session
107	- **Phase definitions**: structured markdown with frontmatter (goal, deliverables, constraints, acceptance criteria)
108	- **Pipeline templates**: YAML files defining stage sequences with dependencies
109	
110	## Conventions
111	
112	- No comments unless the WHY is non-obvious
113	- No docstrings longer than one line
114	- Engine modules are kept under 400 lines each
115	- Dashboard pages are self-contained HTML files that read from `window.ConductorData`
116	- Agent definitions are markdown files with YAML frontmatter
117

52	class ConductorHandler(http.server.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler):
53	    """Serves static files from dashboard/ and handles /api/* routes."""
54	
55	    def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
56	        super().__init__(*args, directory=str(DASHBOARD_ROOT), **kwargs)
57	
58	    def _read_body(self) -> bytes:
59	        length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length", 0) or 0)
60	        return self.rfile.read(length) if length else b""
61	
62	    def _json_body(self) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
63	        raw = self._read_body()
64	        if not raw:
65	            return None
66	        try:
67	            return json.loads(raw)
68	        except (json.JSONDecodeError, ValueError):
69	            return None
70	
71	    def _send_json(self, data: Any, status: int = 200) -> None:
72	        body = json.dumps(data, indent=2).encode("utf-8")
73	        self.send_response(status)
74	        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
75	        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
76	        self.send_header("Access-Control-Allow-Origin", "*")
77	        self.end_headers()
78	        self.wfile.write(body)
79	
80	    def _send_error_json(self, status: int, message: str) -> None:
81	        self._send_json({"error": message}, status)
82	
83	    def _match_session_route(self) -> Optional[tuple]:
84	        path = self.path.split("?")[0]
85	        m = re.match(r"^/api/sessions/(ses_[a-f0-9]+)(?:/(\w+))?$", path)
86	        if m:
87	            return m.group(1), m.group(2)
88	        return None
89	
90	    # --- Session handlers ---
91	
92	    def _handle_get_sessions(self) -> None:
93	        payload = sessions.get_all_sessions_snapshot()
94	        self._send_json(payload)
95	
96	    def _handle_post_sessions(self) -> None:
97	        body = self._json_body()
98	        if not body:
99	            return self._send_error_json(400, "Request body required")
100	
101	        prompt = body.get("prompt", "")
102	        if not prompt:
103	            return self._send_error_json(400, "prompt is required")
104	
105	        project_slug = body.get("project_slug", "")
106	        repo_path = body.get("repo_path", str(REPO_ROOT))
107	        template = body.get("template", "implement")
108	
109	        read_only_templates = {"analyze", "code_review", "investigate"}
110	        use_worktree = template not in read_only_templates
111	
112	        session = sessions.create_session(
113	            project_slug=project_slug,
114	            repo_path=repo_path,
115	            prompt=prompt,
116	            template=template,
117	            model=body.get("model", DEFAULT_CONFIG["default_model"]),
118	            budget_usd=float(body.get("budget_usd", DEFAULT_CONFIG["default_budget_usd"])),
119	            timeout_min=int(body.get("timeout_min", DEFAULT_CONFIG["default_timeout_min"])),
120	            use_worktree=use_worktree,
121	            task_id=body.get("task_id", ""),
122	            task_title=body.get("task_title", ""),
123	        )
124	
125	        print(f"[conductor] Created session {session['id']}")
126	        self._send_json(session, 201)
127	
128	    def _handle_get_session(self, sid: str) -> None:
129	        session = sessions.get_session(sid)
130	        if not session:
131	            return self._send_error_json(404, f"Session {sid} not found")

133	
134	    def _handle_get_output(self, sid: str) -> None:
135	        query = self.path.split("?", 1)[1] if "?" in self.path else ""
136	        params = dict(p.split("=", 1) for p in query.split("&") if "=" in p)
137	        max_lines = int(params.get("lines", "100"))

139	        output = sessions.get_session_output(sid, max_lines)

141	            return self._send_error_json(404, f"Session {sid} not found")

143	
144	    def _handle_cancel_session(self, sid: str) -> None:
145	        ok = sessions.cancel_session(sid)
146	        if not ok:
147	            session = sessions.get_session(sid)
148	            if not session:
149	                return self._send_error_json(404, f"Session {sid} not found")

155	        if not body:
156	            return self._send_error_json(400, "Request body required")

450	                except Empty:
